name: TeamGrid
description: Mortar marketing team grid, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.members: { name; role; image?: ReactNode; bio?: string; links?: { label; href; icon? }[] }[]
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.layout: "grid" | "large" | "list" (default "grid": small square portraits; large: fewer columns of tall portraits; list: each portrait beside the name, role, bio and links)

contract.usage: Import { TeamGrid } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook. Placeholder avatars are hidden because the name is visible.
